dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains the replication code and data for "Relationship-Specificity, Firm Boundary Decisions, and Comparative Advantage" by Mengxiao Liu. Please see the ReadMe for additional details. 

The paper constructs three measures of relationship-specificity (the degree to which inputs are customized to a producer-supplier relationship) at the industry (rs1), industry-pair (rs2) and industry-country (rs3) levels using a global database of between-firm relationships (S&P Capital IQ; 293,966 firm pairs across 171 countries). These measures extend the benchmark index of Nunn (2007) by covering both manufacturing and non-manufacturing industries, allowing variation across industry pairs and across countries within an industry. They are structurally estimated from a property-rights model in which firms' ownership choices depend on productivity and investment retrievability, with parameters recovered using the Adaptive Differential Evolution (ADE) optimizer. The package includes the constructed relationship-specificity measures and the code to estimate the model and reproduce the comparative-advantage analysis, which finds that countries with stronger contracting institutions not only export, but also import more in industries that rely heavily on relationship-specific inputs.
dct_title_s: Replication Data and Code for: Relationship-Specificity, Firm Boundary Decisions, and Comparative Advantage
